verdict.rationale: Marqeta documents an official MCP server that lets your own AI agents work with the payment platform in natural language, including querying and monitoring transactions, issuing virtual cards and setting spend controls. But natural-language operation needs a separate agent you supply, and the docs say the server covers only a designated set of Core API endpoints, so it is not full product operation. Missing for 10: a native first-party natural-language interface, documented coverage of the full Core API (write and admin actions), independent or hands-on corroboration.
